## Functions

### useAggregate()

```ts
function useAggregate<Query>(query, ...args): UseAggregateReturn;
```

Defined in: [src/runtime/vue/composables/use-aggregate.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/runtime/vue/composables/use-aggregate.ts)

Reactive numeric aggregate (count / sum) backed by a Convex query, typically
one that reads from the [Aggregate](https://www.convex.dev/components/aggregate) component. Takes the query's arguments the way `useQuery` does,
`'skip'` included. It never throws: a failed read shows in `error`.
